fix(providence-analytics): support identifiers in nested scopes during AST fragment extraction

- Handle identifiers not found in root scope via full tree traversal
- Add proper type safety with ParsedAst type definitions
- Add validation for AST generation failures
- Refactor logic for clearer init type handling
- Add test coverage for edge cases

fix(providence-analytics): prevent memory leaks in AST traversal

- Fix closure capture in getBinding() to use this.parentScope instead of capturing scope in closure
- Add dispose() method to SwcScope to break circular references between paths, scopes, and bindings
- Wrap find-exports analyzeFile in try/finally to ensure cleanup always runs even on errors
- Replace sourceNodePath with sourceNodeType to prevent callers retaining entire AST graph while still providing useful node type information
- Add comprehensive tests for sourceNodeType functionality and memory leak prevention
